runs.name: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp.; NYSE and TSX AQN, SEC CIK 0001174169, Ontario, 40-F filer reporting in US dollars; Regulated Services Group of electric, water and wastewater, and gas utilities and transmission in the US, Canada, Bermuda and Chile, and a Canadian Hydro Group; renewables (excluding hydro) sold to LS Power 2025-01-08; sale of about 64% of Suralis signed 2026-08-28, not closed; the filing names no rival, Evergy, Ameren and Black Hills chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order key AQN-U (a re-run under Q7, The regulated utility, 2026-10-18), unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, resumed: the 2026-10-27 cycle was stopped by a usage limit after the template copy (999f4088) and framework notes, and this cycle's analyst continued the same run file; the earlier v5 run of 2026-10-18 binds as written and was not opened. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and the competitors derived by the analyst from the 40-F's AIF (business, risk factors) and MD&A (exhibit 99.3). Price **$5.42** (NYSE close 2026-10-27, aggregator, flagged) x **769,901,895 shares** (Q2 2026 MD&A, 2026-08-06, 6-K accession 0001174169-26-000031; 40-F cover 768,351,419, accession 0001174169-26-000015) = cap **$4,173M**; sovereign **5.30%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-27). tools/run.py failed on the 40-F filer; every figure from the filed statements. **Q1 IN** (Regulated Services $508.6M of 2025 operating income, deciding; rate base and earned against allowed return the key variables). **Q2 IN** (the utilities "have geographic monopolies in their service territories"; regulated return carried to Q3 as a second best; against: New Hampshire's Department of Energy moved to dismiss two rate cases over the reliability of financial data and an independent audit was ordered; Missouri staff and Public Counsel moved to dismiss the Empire case, settled at $97M phased in on billing metrics; Apple Valley condemnation before the California Supreme Court). Competitors: the filing names none; Evergy, Ameren and Black Hills chosen as a CONVENTION of the run: utility operating return on plant AQN 4.7% to 5.4% inside the peers' 4.2% to 6.7%, return on common equity AQN -30.7% to 4.5% against 7.6% to 10.9%. **Q3 weighs against** (added plant about 5% pre-tax, about 3.7% after tax; the filer's sustaining capital $105M to $221M a year above depreciation). **Q4 weighs against, no STOP** (clean audit and control opinions; Adjusted Net Earnings per common share featured, 2025 guidance beaten by $0.02 partly through a depreciation deferral and tax adjustments; "one-time" restructuring two years running; $76.4M of 2025 utility earnings HLBV income from tax-equity partners). **Q5 integrity IN, ability against** (the 40-F states the bad news plainly; the circular names "the overall safety context" and not the Lexington explosion; nearly the whole management team new since 2025). **Q6 weighs against on both parts** (shares 274.1M in 2016 to 769.9M; earnings to common 2021 to 2025 -$1,165.2M against dividends paid $1,494.6M; $100 at the start of 2021 worth $53.27 at end-2025; no buybacks, no all-stock deal). **Q7 OUT, on the floor, tested first**: central base the average of FY2024 continuing and FY2025 (a CONVENTION of the run, the window crossing the divestitures), maintenance the filer's sustaining capital under (e), organic growth 3.5% central (total 6.2% beside); owner cash equity-only **-$94.5M a year** after maintenance; literal window negative after all spending every year (average -$524.9M); debt credit $353.4M a year of long-term debt increase (securitized Empire bonds out) against growth spending, capped at 57.1%, the business's own long-term debt share (allowed shares stated for single utilities, no rate base by utility), binding, $71.6M in the base. **Value range -$3.70 to -$2.32 a share equity-only (central)**; most favourable case found (FY2025, depreciation as maintenance, 6.2%) $4.48 to $6.15 at the sovereign, the price inside it; highest value at ten percent of any case $2.68. **Fair price -$1.65 equity-only, central, not positive**; -$6.81 all-equity beside; the most favourable variant $2.53 equity-only. Suralis valued as if closed beside: at most +$0.16 a share. Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed: debt 1.44 times equity, goodwill 28% of equity, regulatory assets $1.42B, parent-level debt with $140.2M of corporate interest in 2025, pre-tax interest cover 1.75 times, the Mountain View Fire and Lexington explosion liabilities with no estimable upper end. Strongest evidence against, as the analyst put it: owner cash after maintenance negative or thin, and returns conditioned by regulators on data quality and billing. Framework gaps for the operator: (1) a divestiture inside the five-year window; (2) utility sustaining capital that earns the allowed return, as maintenance or growth; (3) the debt-credit cap undecidable without rate base by utility; (4) no alert rule for a negative utility fair price; (5) no tax rate set for the all-equity interest add-back. Could not get: rate base and earned return by utility; continuing-business cash flows for 2021 to 2023; Suralis's own owner cash; the tax carryforward schedule (not read); 2016 and 2017 balance sheets in US dollars. Ordering departure declared by the analyst: the Q7 arithmetic was computed and committed, headed COMPUTATION, before Q2 to Q6 were written, with the operator rule 9 risk named. Analyst's commits: pathspec commits of its own paths, one per question, a113d4bb to 6bec1198. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; 100 id citations resolve, no E-ids, no citation slip, 58 adjacent fragment pairs checked, seven checker mispairings resolved by hand ("where the business will be in 10 years" belongs to M2000-037 after M2012-065; "decent returns on the incremental sums they invest" to L2009-012 after M2009-104; the "cash-consuming businesses" quote to M2012-057 after L2009-012; "little or no debt" cited to no id after L2023-009; "Adjusted Net Earnings per common share" the filer's own term beside L2016-006; "at least $1 of market value" to R1995-009 after M1998-110; "It should scream at you" to M2009-005 before M1996-084); no tracked research file over 200 KB (the filings in the ignored cache/). Contamination declared: another company's file names in git status, CTAS commit subjects and queue counts from memory; none about AQN, none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the central fair price is not positive and the central case is already the organic pair.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor (re-run under Q7, The regulated utility, resumed after a usage limit): a holding company of regulated electric, water and gas utilities after the renewables sale, its owner cash equity-only after the filer's sustaining capital -$94.5M a year in the central base and negative after all spending every year of the window, built by issuing shares (274.1M to 769.9M since 2016) while regulators condition its returns; value -$3.70 to -$2.32 equity-only against $5.42, the price inside even the most favourable range at the sovereign. Fair -$1.65 equity-only, not positive; -$6.81 all-equity; not armed.
